AcceptedRisk.description:
One finding a human decision-maker has explicitly accepted as risk.

``expires_at``, when present, must be later than the enclosing
:class:`DecisionRecord`'s ``decided_at`` — a comparison against a
sibling artifact-level field enforced by ``DecisionRecord`` itself
(not by this model in isolation), and one with no standard JSON Schema
vocabulary; it is documented as a runtime-only invariant (see
``docs/api-a2b1-review-decision-artifacts.md``).
AcceptedRisk.title: AcceptedRisk

AgentRunReference.description:
An identity claim about one agent run that participated in a slice instance.

Records identity claims only — ``run_id``, ``executor_actor_id``, and
the optional ``framework``/``model``/``provider`` fields are exactly
what is claimed by whoever assembled the bundle. This is not a
top-level artifact: it carries no content digest, and this model does
not authenticate the run, the actor, the framework, the model, or the
provider.
AgentRunReference.title: AgentRunReference

ArtifactFindingLocation.description:
A finding location anchored to another ZADC artifact by ID.

Does not perform repository lookup or cross-artifact reference
resolution — ``artifact_id`` is recorded as claimed only.
ArtifactFindingLocation.title: ArtifactFindingLocation

ArtifactReference.description:
A reference to another canonical ZADC artifact by ID and content digest.

Distinct from :class:`EvidenceReference`, which points at an external,
non-ZADC evidence payload rather than another sealed ZADC artifact.
ArtifactReference.title: ArtifactReference

BundleBlocker.description:
One structural blocker surfaced by a bundle's recorded derived state.

A blocker is structural derived-state output — a recorded claim about
what is blocking, and why, with supporting artifact references. It is
**not** a :class:`~zadc.models.review_report.Finding` and not a new
authority-bearing artifact. This model does not implement blocker
severity, finding closure, or policy thresholds.
BundleBlocker.title: BundleBlocker

CertificationManifest.description: Trusted verification results bound to an exact subject (architecture 11.3).
CertificationManifest.title: CertificationManifest

Changes.description: The set of commits, changed files, and resolved dependency pins.
Changes.title: Changes

CompletionReport.description: The execution agent's completion claim (architecture section 11.2).
CompletionReport.title: CompletionReport

DecisionRecord.description:
An authenticated human decision claim (architecture A2B1).

A structurally valid ``DecisionRecord`` does not, by itself, authenticate
its human identity and does not confer merge authorization — a later
trusted validator must bind the identity and verify policy and live
repository state. This model enforces only internal structural
consistency: the envelope producer must claim to be the same human
identity as ``decided_by``, and the decision-specific field gates below
must hold.
DecisionRecord.title: DecisionRecord

DecisionSubject.description:
The exact subject a :class:`DecisionRecord` claims to decide about.

``decision_subject_sha`` and ``current_pr_head_sha_observed`` are not
required to match at model construction — freshness and live-head
reconciliation between the decided-upon subject and the repository's
current state are deferred to a later validation slice. This model
does not query GitHub or verify either SHA against a live source.
DecisionSubject.title: DecisionSubject

DependencyPinResolution.description: The observed resolution of one packet-declared dependency pin.
DependencyPinResolution.title: DependencyPinResolution

DerivedStateSnapshot.description:
A recorded snapshot of validator-computed derived state for a bundle.

``state`` is an opaque stable identifier in this slice — not a
lifecycle enum defined here. ``validator_actor_id`` and
``validator_run_id`` are claims recorded by the bundle; no trust
binding is performed against them. This model does not prove that its
``state``, ``blockers``, ``stale_artifact_refs``, or
``next_admissible_actions`` are correct — it only records what a
validator reported, structurally self-consistent within the snapshot.
Cross-checking these references against the enclosing bundle's
top-level artifact references is performed by
:class:`~zadc.models.workflow_bundle.WorkflowBundle`, not by this
model in isolation.
DerivedStateSnapshot.title: DerivedStateSnapshot

EvidenceArtifact.description:
Metadata and binding for one piece of external verification evidence.

``digest`` is the SHA-256 digest of the external evidence payload and
is semantically and structurally distinct from the inherited
``provenance.content_digest``, which seals this artifact's own
canonical envelope content rather than the referenced external payload.
EvidenceArtifact.title: EvidenceArtifact

EvidenceReference.description:
A pointer to an external evidence payload (architecture section 11.3).

Carries the evidence identifier, its media type, the payload's own
SHA-256 digest, and a trusted URI/provider location. This is a
lightweight, denormalized reference distinct from a full
:class:`~zadc.models.evidence_artifact.EvidenceArtifact` record — it
does not carry availability, size, or a description.
EvidenceReference.title: EvidenceReference

ExactSubject.description:
The exact commit subject a verification run or evidence item targets.

Shared by :class:`~zadc.models.certification_manifest.CertificationManifest`
and :class:`~zadc.models.evidence_artifact.EvidenceArtifact` (A2A-07).
This model records the claimed subject identity only; it does not
inspect Git ancestry or diff content.
ExactSubject.title: ExactSubject

ExecutorClaim.description:
A material statement authored by an execution agent (architecture section 12).

Defaults to ``AGENT_REPORTED`` epistemic status. Construction never
automatically promotes a claim to ``VERIFIED`` or any stronger status —
upgrading epistemic status requires evidence or human judgment applied
by a later validation slice, not this model.
ExecutorClaim.title: ExecutorClaim

FileFindingLocation.description:
A finding location anchored to a file (and optional line range).

Rejects fields belonging only to another location variant
(``artifact_id``, ``description``) via strict ``extra="forbid"``. Does
not verify that the referenced file or line range exists.
FileFindingLocation.title: FileFindingLocation

Finding.description:
One review finding with a typed location and lifecycle status.

Does not verify that a resolution reference resolves or actually
closes the finding — ``resolution_refs`` records claimed resolution
evidence only.
Finding.title: Finding

GeneralFindingLocation.description: A finding location with no file or artifact anchor — free-text only.
GeneralFindingLocation.title: GeneralFindingLocation

HumanDecisionIdentity.description:
The claimed human identity that authored a :class:`DecisionRecord`.

``actor_type`` is fixed to ``human`` — a decision record can never be
produced by an agent, CI, validator, or service actor. This model
records the claimed identity only; authenticating it against a trusted
identity provider is deferred to a later validation slice.
HumanDecisionIdentity.title: HumanDecisionIdentity

LaneResult.description: The result of one verification lane run.
LaneResult.title: LaneResult

Observation.description: A timestamped statement derived from a named source (architecture 8.14).
Observation.title: Observation

ObservationSource.description:
The identity of the live source an :class:`~zadc.models.observation.Observation`
was drawn from (architecture section 8.14).
ObservationSource.title: ObservationSource

PacketAuthorization.description: The trusted human authorization binding for a packet (architecture 11.1).
PacketAuthorization.title: PacketAuthorization

PacketIntent.description: The authorized problem statement and desired outcome.
PacketIntent.title: PacketIntent

PacketReview.description: The packet's independent-review requirement and blocking threshold.
PacketReview.title: PacketReview

PacketScope.description: The authorized and prohibited paths and operations for a packet.
PacketScope.title: PacketScope

PolicyReference.description:
Reference to the policy governing an artifact.

Fields (architecture section 10, ``policy``):
- ``policy_id``: the policy identifier (e.g. ``zutfen:zadc-policy:standard@0.1.0``).
- ``policy_source_sha``: the trusted commit SHA the policy was loaded from.
- ``policy_digest``: the SHA-256 digest of the policy content.
PolicyReference.title: PolicyReference

ProducerIdentity.description:
Identity of the actor that produced an artifact.

Fields (architecture section 10, ``producer``):
- ``actor_type``: human, agent, ci, validator, service.
- ``actor_id``: URI-shaped global identifier for the actor.
- ``run_id``: optional run/execution identifier.
- ``model``: optional model identifier (for agent producers).
- ``provider``: optional provider/service identifier.
ProducerIdentity.title: ProducerIdentity

Provenance.description:
Provenance chain for an artifact.

Fields (architecture section 10, ``provenance``):
- ``parent_artifact_ids``: REQUIRED immutable tuple of parent artifact IDs.
  Accepted as ``list`` or ``tuple`` at construction; internally immutable.
  Root artifacts must explicitly supply an empty array/tuple.
- ``content_digest``: optional SHA-256 digest of the artifact content.
  May be absent only before sealing.
Provenance.title: Provenance

Reconciliation.description:
Enumerates intervening commits when the observed work-start SHA does
not match the packet's expected work-start SHA (architecture 13, INV-002).

``intervening_commits`` MUST be non-empty — an empty reconciliation
would satisfy the presence gate on :class:`WorkStartObservation` without
actually enumerating any commit, defeating the INV-002 accountability
requirement. ``minItems: 1`` is schema-model-owned via ``Field``.

``uniqueItems`` is emitted as a best-effort schema signal (it rejects
fully identical entries), but JSON Schema cannot express "no duplicate
``sha`` across items with otherwise-differing disposition/rationale" —
that narrower sha-uniqueness invariant is enforced at runtime only,
by :meth:`_check_unique_shas`.
Reconciliation.title: Reconciliation

ReconciliationCommit.description: One intervening commit enumerated by a work-start reconciliation record.
ReconciliationCommit.title: ReconciliationCommit

RepositoryState.description: The observed repository state at completion-report time.
RepositoryState.title: RepositoryState

RepositoryTarget.description: The repository identity and optional pull-request target of a packet.
RepositoryTarget.title: RepositoryTarget

Requirement.description: One normative requirement with its acceptance criteria.
Requirement.title: Requirement

ReviewIndependence.description:
The reviewer's independence claim relative to the executing actor.

Records that ``executor_actor_id`` was the executing actor and whether
independence was ``satisfied``. This is an internal-consistency check
only (see :class:`ReviewReport`) — it does not prove trusted reviewer
independence.
ReviewIndependence.title: ReviewIndependence

ReviewInputs.description: The diffs, files, and evidence artifacts a review claims to cover.
ReviewInputs.title: ReviewInputs

ReviewReport.description:
A reviewer's structured judgment of an exact subject (architecture A2B1).

Preserves the distinction between reviewer judgment and authenticated
human authority: this artifact records what a reviewer examined and
concluded, and records — but does not authenticate or derive —
reviewer independence. ``reviewer_recommendation`` is judgment only and
must never be treated as merge authorization.
ReviewReport.title: ReviewReport

ReviewSubject.description:
The exact subject a :class:`ReviewReport` claims to have examined.

This model records the claimed subject identity only; it does not
inspect Git, retrieve evidence, or prove that the listed inputs were
actually reviewed.
ReviewSubject.title: ReviewSubject

ReviewedFile.description: One file (or file range) claimed as reviewed input.
ReviewedFile.title: ReviewedFile

ReviewerIdentity.description:
Identity of the reviewer that produced a :class:`ReviewReport`.

Distinct from :class:`~zadc.models.common.ProducerIdentity` in that
``actor_type`` is narrowed to ``human`` or ``agent`` — a reviewer is
never a ``ci``, ``validator``, or ``service`` actor. This model records
the reviewer's claimed identity; it does not authenticate it.
ReviewerIdentity.title: ReviewerIdentity

VerificationClaims.description: The executor-reported local verification commands and results.
VerificationClaims.title: VerificationClaims

VerificationEnvironment.description: The trusted execution environment for a certification run (architecture 11.3).
VerificationEnvironment.title: VerificationEnvironment

VerificationRequirements.description: The mandatory/advisory verification lanes and exact-subject policy.
VerificationRequirements.title: VerificationRequirements

WorkStartAuthorization.description: The authorized work-start commit and mismatch policy (architecture 13).
WorkStartAuthorization.title: WorkStartAuthorization

WorkStartObservation.description: The observed work-start SHA versus the packet's expected SHA.
WorkStartObservation.title: WorkStartObservation

WorkflowBundle.description:
The canonical aggregate for one slice instance (architecture 8.15, 11.6).

Links the authorized packet, agent runs, and every downstream artifact
produced for a slice instance by stable ID and content digest, plus a
recorded ``derived_state`` snapshot. A bundle MUST NOT override the
contents of referenced artifacts — it never embeds full artifacts in
this slice, and it does not verify that a referenced ``artifact_id``
actually resolves to a sealed artifact of the collection's claimed
type (that referential-integrity check is deferred to a later
validation slice).
WorkflowBundle.title: WorkflowBundle

description: The global, artifact_type-discriminated union of every concrete ZADC v0.1 artifact (Packet, CompletionReport, CertificationManifest, EvidenceArtifact, Observation, ReviewReport, DecisionRecord, WorkflowBundle) for the Zutfen Agentic Development Contract v0.1 (architecture section A2B2). Dispatches each payload to its exact concrete artifact schema by its artifact_type discriminator.
title: ZADC Artifact
